links.comparator_used: No Tools baseline (LLM answering from internal knowledge only)
links.outcome: HPO term extraction F1, mapping error rate and precision across five LLMs
links.effect: Mean aggregate F1 0.46 (SD 0.22) to 0.72 (SD 0.15), p<0.001; Mapping Error Rate 40.9% to 7.8%, p<0.001; Precision 56% to 90%; Qwen3 F1 0.11 to 0.50; inferred phenotype F1 0.20 to 0.34 (p<0.001)
links.tradeoff: No significant increase in hallucination rate for inferred phenotypes (p = 0.08).
links.quote: Tool augmentation significantly improved performance across all models.

links.outcome: HPO extraction F1, precision and mapping error rate with real-time HPO ontology retrieval
links.effect: Mean aggregate F1 0.46 to 0.72 (p<0.001); Mapping Error Rate 40.9% to 7.8% (p<0.001); Precision 56% to 90%
links.quote: Mean aggregate F1-score increased from 0.46 (SD 0.22) in the baseline condition to 0.72 (SD 0.15) with tools (p < 0.001).
